note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Prepare statements run in one PowerShell session with the episode folder as current directory; variables do not survive into the screens, so each screen re-derives what it needs.
prepare: # owner signs in before the run: az login (as labadmin, lab subscription selected) and gh auth login (scopes repo, workflow, read:packages, delete_repo, delete:packages)
gh repo create "$owner/$repo" --public --description "DEVLADLOG Dev Tools #5 demo (throwaway)"
$o = az deployment group create -g $rg -f "$app\infra\main.bicep" -p appName=$appName githubSubject=$subj --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json
# the outputs stay in $o and are never printed; wait for the federated credential to propagate (AADSTS70021)

@{ reviewers = @(@{ type = 'User'; id = [int]$uid }); prevent_self_review = $false; deployment_branch_policy = @{ protected_branches = $false; custom_branch_policies = $true } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | gh api -X PUT "repos/$owner/$repo/environments/production" --input -
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\work\ep05 | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\work\ep05\$repo -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
git config user.name 'Alex Demo'; git config user.email 'alex.demo@contoso.com'
git add -A; git commit -m 'chore: import orders api'; git push -u origin main

# owner, now: GitHub > profile > Packages > orders-app-ci-demo > Package settings > Change visibility > Public (once the first publish job is green), then approve the waiting deployment in the Actions tab
gh run watch (gh run list --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId') --exit-status
# prepare the pull request of the first screen, do not open it yet
git add -A; git commit -m 'feat(orders): name the service in healthz'; git push -u origin feat/service-name

screens.name: prchecks
steps: In Windows Terminal (C:\work\ep05\orders-app-ci-demo) run: gh pr create --fill
Open the pull request, scroll to the checks list: guardrails, build-test and e2e green; publish and deploy skipped
Open the Checks tab, the e2e job, expand the step that runs scripts/e2e.sh: 'docker compose up' with db Healthy, the SQL Server tests (Passed: 4), then the smoke lines ending '7 passed, 0 failed'
Open the run Summary page: the Tests tables (unit and SQL Server) and the Smoke test list
mask: Azure subscription id, tenant id and client id (the portal does not mask them)
labadmin account picker and e-mail in the Azure portal
GitHub avatar/menu, and the owner name if it is not the public lab account
never show the Azure CLI deployment output

screens.name: package
steps: Merge the pull request first (squash, the title is the commit message) and wait for the publish job of the main run
Open Packages > orders-app-ci-demo: tags sha-<commit> and main, digest visible
Open the publish job Summary: image, digest, verify command

In Windows Terminal run: gh attestation verify oci://ghcr.io/<owner>/orders-app-ci-demo@<digest> -R <owner>/orders-app-ci-demo   (digest copied from the page) and keep the success output with the signer workflow .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml
mask: Azure subscription id, tenant id and client id (the portal does not mask them)
labadmin account picker and e-mail in the Azure portal
GitHub avatar/menu, and the owner name if it is not the public lab account
never show the Azure CLI deployment output

screens.name: approval
screens.account: the lab GitHub account (reviewer of the production environment)
steps: Open the ci-cd run on main: graph with guardrails, build-test, e2e, publish green and deploy 'Waiting'
Capture the graph, then click Review deployments, tick production, comment 'release', click Approve and deploy
Capture the graph again with deploy running
mask: Azure subscription id, tenant id and client id (the portal does not mask them)
labadmin account picker and e-mail in the Azure portal
GitHub avatar/menu, and the owner name if it is not the public lab account
never show the Azure CLI deployment output

screens.name: live
screens.account: the lab GitHub account; the Azure portal only for the optional Deployment Center shot (labadmin)
steps: Open the deploy job log: azure/login 'Login successful' (OIDC), webapps-deploy, then the smoke step polling and '/healthz ok and version <sha>' and '4 passed, 0 failed'
Click the environment URL in the run graph and open /healthz: version equals the merge commit SHA, database Sqlite, user app
Place the commit on GitHub (its SHA) next to the JSON; optional: Azure portal > the web app > Deployment Center > Logs showing the image ghcr.io/...:sha-<commit>
mask: Azure subscription id, tenant id and client id (the portal does not mask them)
labadmin account picker and e-mail in the Azure portal
GitHub avatar/menu, and the owner name if it is not the public lab account
never show the Azure CLI deployment output

teardown: # owner: gh auth refresh -s delete:packages,delete_repo (once), later gh auth refresh -r delete:packages,delete_repo to drop the scopes
$owner = gh api user --jq .login; gh api -X DELETE /user/packages/container/orders-app-ci-demo
